claims.statement: EHDS requires Health Data Access Bodies, data permits, dataset catalogs, and secure processing environments for covered secondary use; most secondary-use rules start applying in March 2029, with remaining categories later.

contrary_evidence: Most EHDS secondary-use obligations do not apply until 2029, and public bodies may make catalogs sufficiently usable without a paid intermediary.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: catalog normalization plus customer-permitted application timelines and refusal reasons create a unique procurement-outcome layer
fingerprint.customer: EU biotech, medtech, outcomes-research, and health-AI teams planning secondary-data studies
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: biostatistics firms, CROs, and health-economics consultancies embed the index in study design
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: normalized dataset index, field fit, access route, permit checklist, lead-time evidence, and comparables
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the sponsor pays at protocol-feasibility sign-off or annual procurement renewal
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a study team must freeze endpoints and data requirements before submitting a permit application

founder_fit: Excellent health-data, neuroscience, and data-science fit; analysis can be delivered asynchronously and no patient data need be held.
risks: Metadata can become stale or misrepresent actual cohort availability.
Advice could be mistaken for legal or ethics approval.

structure.control_point: the dataset and jurisdiction decision made before protocol lock and a health-data permit application
structure.critical_dependency: usable HDAB catalog metadata, lawful public or licensed metadata aggregation, and enough completed applications to estimate access outcomes

thesis: Normalize the future Health Data Access Body catalogs into field-level feasibility, expected permit route, secure-environment constraints, and observed access lead times so research sponsors can choose datasets before locking a protocol. Start with existing national access bodies and sell readiness work before broad EHDS application. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: EHDS Dataset Feasibility Procurement Index
uncertainties: Pre-2029 willingness to pay is unknown.
Rights to republish national catalog metadata must be checked jurisdiction by jurisdiction.
